title: Type confusion in PostgreSQL SQL-language functions allows an object creator to execute arbitrary code as the…
description: A type confusion vulnerability in PostgreSQL SQL-language functions allows an object creator to execute arbitrary code with the privileges of the operating system user running the database. This occurs via an output parameter of type "any". Versions before PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, and 14.25 are affected.
